tags.name: Chinatown
tags.note: There is no agreed-upon boundary of Melbourne's Chinatown on Little Bourke Street. The extent from the West Gate to the East Gate and half way in to each block north and south is a sensible compromise in the absence of a formal definition.

tags.name: Little Italy
tags.note: There is no agreed-upon boundary of Melbourne's Little Italy on Lygon Street. This simple rectangle along the Italian part of the street should be considered preliminary.

tags.name: Keon Park
tags.name:etymology: Named for Keon Park Pty. Ltd., the property development company established in 1924 which presumably bought this land and sold it off in parcels. http://whittleseahistoricalsociety.org.au/index.php/essays/93-keon-park
tags.note: An informal name for this area, not officially recognised but commonly used by residents. The borders as depicted here (in particular the southern border) are approximate only.

tags.comment: Taylors road curved bit may not be absolute boundary. Aproximate.
